instruction.name: xvsadd.hu
instruction.description: Saturating add corresponding unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b`, store the result to `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
